% A revtex4 article for rmp, with \appendix*. It checks a case the fix
% must not break. rmp adds its appendix code after the class's test for
% the star, which then never sees it: the PDF shows the star as text and
% letters the sections, as after \appendix, and puts "Appendix:" before
% a starred section. The build must finish, with no "unskip" in the page.
\documentclass[rmp]{revtex4}
\begin{document}
\title{Revfour rmp appendix}
\author{Someone}
\maketitle
\section{First section}
Text of the first section.
\appendix*
\section{Details}
Text of the details.
\section*{Starred tail}
Text of the starred tail.
\end{document}
